source.figure_table: Figure 1 (F vs A erythroblast qRT-PCR and ddRT-PCR; HUDEP2 + primary cultures)

context.model: HUDEP2 erythroid cell line; stage-matched F/A erythroblasts sorted by FACS (CD71+CD235+; F cells vs bottom-20% HbF− cells)
context.intervention: none (baseline F vs A comparison; hydroxyurea/pomalidomide sensitivity noted)

observation.assay: γ-globin mRNA: qRT-PCR (~100-fold enriched in F vs A) and ddRT-PCR (γ-globin = ~30% of total globin transcripts in F cells)
observation.unit: % of total globin transcripts in F cells (qRT-PCR: ~100-fold enrichment vs A; ddRT-PCR: γ = ~30% of total globin)
observation.time_point: day 7 of differentiation (stage-matched F vs A; HUDEP2)
observation.evidence_locator: Blood 2020; PMC7256358; Figure 1B; ddRT-PCR (F/A ratio ~100; γ = ~30% of globin in F cells)

note: F/A sorting matched by FACS gating on CD71+CD235+ and HbF staining (bottom 20% HbF− cells as A cells; 'matched by CD71, CD235 and size' per the design spec). F erythroblasts carry γ-globin at ~100-fold vs A in qRT-PCR; ~30% of total globin in F cells by ddRT-PCR.
